scope: Observed optional MCP plus backend runtime on CPython 3.12.13 Linux x86-64; exact 29 selected wheels and bounded source-notice collection. No development-tool inventory or dependency binaries are redistributed here.
limitations: This is an observed platform inventory, not a cross-platform installation lock or proof of all linked binary components.
Wheel all-target SBOM and source Cargo.lock membership can exceed actual linked membership; source association does not prove reproducibility.
License expressions retain upstream alternatives and exceptions without selecting terms or asserting legal compliance.
OpenSSL named legal/declaration collection is bounded; independent inline-header coverage is not established.
CFFI tagged recipe and exported symbol corroborate the libffi association, not complete binary provenance.

Health Buddy source distributions retain these texts; Health Buddy wheels do not bundle external dependency binaries. Runtime images and binary dependency bundles need their own exact-artifact qualification.
